vi.interpretation: VI-manager retrace counter; event type 13, VI context swap path

common_updates.interpretation: Common timer/update calls via scheduler event 0x29a; includes menus and pause UI; not proof that every gameplay subsystem advances at this rate

graphics_done.interpretation: Scheduler graphics-completion message counter type 2; completed graphics tasks, not host presents

os_time.interpretation: VI-manager accumulated COP0 Count clock, two big-endian words

logic_ticks.interpretation: Eligible player logical input/state steps in 0x800acb94; increment store 0x800acfe4 when context field +0x23b2 equals 1. Resets on scene initialization; not a count of completed updates of every subsystem.

state_updates.interpretation: State/update-and-draw dispatch count: increment 0x800ccf24 before call 0x80070118. Resets at scene initialization.

mode_id.interpretation: Mode/state identifier used to reject samples spanning a mode change; not a universal scene identifier.
